mapper.sql: A.AGREE_NO, A.AGREE_ID, A.AGREE_NAME, A.PERSON_ID, A.EMPID, A.LOCAL_NAME, (SELECT GET_DEPT_NAME(H.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) FROM HR_EMPLOYEE H WHERE H.EMPID = A.EMPID AND H.CPNY_ID = A.CPNY_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS DEPART_NAME, TO_CHAR(A.CON_START_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS CON_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(A.CON_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS CON_END_DATE, TO_CHAR(A.STUDY_START_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS STUDY_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(A.STUDY_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS STUDY_END_DATE, A.STUDY_DAY, TO_CHAR(A.SER_START_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS SER_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(A.SER_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS SER_END_DATE, A.SERVICE_YEAR, A.EXCHANGE_RATE, A.TOTAL_FEE, TO_CHAR(A.LEFT_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS LEFT_DATE, A.HQ_FREE, A.CGFY_FREE, A.JP_FREE, A.ZFBZ_FREE, A.CGBZ_FREE, A.CGBZ_FREE_FACT, A.SYBX_FREE, A.YX_PAY, A.JT_FREE, A.TX_FREE, A.FACT_PAY, TO_CHAR(A.AGREE_START_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS AGREE_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(A.AGREE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS AGREE_END_DATE, A.REMARK
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM EDU_TRAIN_AGREEMENT A WHERE A.ACTIVITY = '1' AND A.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND A.EMPID IN ( SELECT H.EMPID FROM HR_EMPLOYEE H WHERE H.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND H.DEPTNO IN ( SELECT D.DEPTNO FROM HR_DEPARTMENT D START WITH D.DEPTNO = #{deptNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} CONNECT BY PRIOR D.DEPTNO = D.PARENT_DEPT_NO ) )
AND (UPPER(A.EMPID) = UPPER(#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) OR CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(A.LOCAL_NAME)) LIKE '%' || CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) || '%')
AND A.CON_START_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{conStartDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
AND A.CON_END_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{conEndDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
ORDER BY A.CREATE_DATE DESC
SELECT MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(T.AGREE_ID, 4))) FROM EDU_TRAIN_AGREEMENT T WHERE T.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T.AGREE_ID LIKE 'TRA%' AND REGEXP_LIKE(SUBSTR(T.AGREE_ID, 4), '^[0-9]+$')

mapper.update: UPDATE EDU_TRAIN_AGREEMENT SET AGREE_NAME = #{agreeName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PERSON_ID = #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EMPID = #{empid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, LOCAL_NAME = #{localName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CON_START_DATE = TO_DATE(#{conStartDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), CON_END_DATE = TO_DATE(#{conEndDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), STUDY_START_DATE = TO_DATE(#{studyStartDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), STUDY_END_DATE = TO_DATE(#{studyEndDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), STUDY_DAY = #{studyDay, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HQ_FREE = #{hqFree, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CGFY_FREE = #{cgfyFree, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, JP_FREE = #{jpFree, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ZFBZ_FREE = #{zfbzFree, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CGBZ_FREE = #{cgbzFree, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CGBZ_FREE_FACT = #{cgbzFreeFact, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYBX_FREE = #{sybxFree, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, YX_PAY = #{yxPay, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, JT_FREE = #{jtFree, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TX_FREE = #{txFree, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FACT_PAY = #{factPay, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, AGREE_START_DATE = TO_DATE(#{agreeStartDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), AGREE_END_DATE = TO_DATE(#{agreeEndDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), REMARK = #{remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_IP = #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE AGREE_NO = #{agreeNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
